title: UAP fly around government teams at events while the teams do not notice

tellings.quote: We are arriving in the first day, and around their west fly NAYA, and They have no idea.

plain: James Valor, from a startup called Skywatcher that says it can call in UFOs, says that at government test events in the early 2020s, unexplained flying objects flew around the government teams on the very first day. According to him, the teams had no idea it was happening. If true, the objects were right there and trained people were missing them.
